ruleDefinitions.name: Whoami.EXE Execution From Privileged Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "whoami.exe" by privileged accounts that are often abused by threat actors

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "whoami\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$")) AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*TrustedInstaller.*")))
